text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Fenomeno got injured, so I brought her to 
the nurse's office.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
“I apologize for showing you such a 
pathetic display, sir...!”

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Boss... I have a favor to ask.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
"Would you please allow me to return to 
training, sir!"

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Of course,
only within what is manageable. 
I will make sure it does not affect your 
injury, so please—

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
I cannot possibly back down now,
not after 
showing such a shameful display...

When you put it that way, I can't ...

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: That... that may be true, but...!
choice_data_list: I don't think now is the time to w...
When you put it like that, I have ...

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Heh... That is true. Well then, please 
keep me company when the time comes.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Now then, this officer shall devote 
herself entirely to recovery. In order to 
run with Boss once again, I shall rest 
with all my might, sir!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
As expected of the Boss. I had faith you 
would say that! Well then—

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
...Please, say no more. Your eyes alone 
convey everything, sir...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Due to reckless training, the injury 
worsened, forcing her into rehabilitation 
until she fully recovered.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Even though it's just a light stretch... 
right now... it really hits the spot...

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
As expected of a training menu devised by 
the Boss!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Yes, let's take it steady and sure!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Fenomeno kept striving without getting 
discouraged even through the hardest 
times, making a smooth and successful 
comeback.
